title: Caitlin Clark proves there's no NBA 2K27 cover curse as Fever set franchise scoring record
text:
Caitlin Clark posted 27 points and 11 assists as the Indiana Fever set a franchise scoring record in a 123-88 blowout of the Connecticut Sun.

The letter addresses concerns about Caitlin Clark's treatment, with reports suggesting some attacks are racially motivated. Dakich questions the coach's failure to defend her star player and the league's lack of support, despite Congress's involvement in the matter.kept their momentum rolling Wednesday night, cruising to a third straight victory with a 123-88 rout of the Connecticut Sun.
Just hours after being unveiled as an NBA 2K27 cover athlete, Caitlin Clark led the way with 27 points and 11 assists for another double-double. Clark's teammate, Kelsey Mitchell, added 23 points and the Fever set a franchise record for points in a game. Indiana Fever guard Caitlin Clark is introduced before the game against the Connecticut Sun on July 22, 2026, at Gainbridge Fieldhouse in Indianapolis, Indiana.
The Fever also had the biggest half in franchise history when they led 70-46 at the break. It was the third-highest scoring game in league history without overtime. Monique Billings and Tyasha Harris added 12 points apiece for Indiana, while the Fever connected on 11 of 22 attempts from beyond the arc.

The Fever will now turn their attention to All-Star weekend, with Clark, Boston and Kelsey Mitchell set to represent Indiana in Chicago.
